_comment: The only list of the languages a build can be made in (docs/guides/ADDING_A_LANGUAGE.md).
code: VITA_LOCALE / -Locale value and tools/locales/<code>/ folder. gameLanguage: LANGUAGE_*
the game is built with (GAME_LANGUAGE). romCode: 4th letter of the cartridge's game code
(BPR?), null when the language has no official cartridge. romSha1: SHA-1 of the clean official
cartridge dump the game text is extracted from (source rom). letters: the letters beyond ASCII
and the base set (BASE_LETTERS in tools/locales/compile_ui.py) this language's UI fonts need;
every one is baked once by tools/ui2/bake_locale_glyphs.py and only the build's own go into its
atlas (tools/ui2/build_atlas.py --locale). source: none (the sources' English) or rom (the
player's official cartridge, through tools/locales/<code>/manifest.json.gz and
tools/locales/localize.py). units: imperial or metric, for the Pokedex heights and
